braillify
Copyright the braillify contributors.

This product is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see LICENSE).

It bundles the following third-party data files.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
libs/braillify/resources/hanja-readings.txt
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Derived from the Unicode® Unihan Database (the `kHangul` property of
Unihan_Readings.txt), which maps a Han ideograph to its Korean reading.

Copyright © 1991-2026 Unicode, Inc.

Distributed under the Unicode License v3:
https://www.unicode.org/license.txt

Unicode and the Unicode Logo are registered trademarks of Unicode, Inc. in the
United States and other countries. This project is not endorsed by Unicode, Inc.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
libs/braillify/resources/cmudict.dict
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The CMU Pronouncing Dictionary.

Copyright © 1993-2014 Carnegie Mellon University.

Distributed under the 2-clause BSD license; see the header of the file itself
for the full text.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
test_cases/<year>_corpus/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Transcriptions imported from the 국립국어원 한국어-한국점자 병렬 말뭉치
(NIKL Korean-Korean Braille Parallel Corpus), used as benchmark reference data.
The original distribution archives are not redistributed here.
